title: Family Visit
tips:
- The Family Visit status is intended for family visits or short-term stays with Japanese nationals or residents.

- Depending on the relationship and circumstances, a stay period of up to 90 days is typically granted.

- Documents from both the applicant and the guarantor (a relative residing in Japan) are required.

- Please check the latest requirements on the Immigration Services Agency website.
